mission.name: Lady D Trilogy Finalization
mission.tagline: Let every page sound lived, every cover feel luminous, and every companion deepen the journey.
mission.northStar: Three Scripture-faithful devotionals in Susan 'Lady D' Damon's lived preaching voice, paired with useful journals and a luminous, coherent cover family ready for author review and KDP production.

policies.notes: Production artifacts remain on the dedicated finalization branch until manuscript, PDF, cover, and site gates all pass. Existing unrelated untracked July files are excluded.

phases.title: Source Reconciliation
phases.goal: Lock the August author exemplar, transcript-derived cover brief, current 1,098-day voice corpus, protected Scripture data, and Kimi journal strengths as a reproducible baseline.

tasks.title: Inventory manuscripts, exemplar, cover evidence, and journal sources
tasks.notes: Lady D's August 3 Exodus 15:4 email is the voice calibration target; her bright golden wraparound example is the cover calibration target.

tasks.title: Record protected fields and baseline language metrics
tasks.notes: Scripture, translation label, root/language lens, and correlative thread are immutable during prose polish.

phases.title: Voice Polish
phases.goal: Remove mechanical surrender phrasing and template residue across all 1,098 entries while preserving Lady D's warm, direct, Scripture-led preaching voice.

gates.title: Voice corpus invariants and repetition checks pass
Humanizer delta report shows no corpus regression
gates.notes: Humanizer is advisory evidence; theological and author-voice review remain primary.

tasks.title: Polish surrender language and sentence cadence across three volumes
tasks.notes: Protect Volume I Day 2 as the gold exemplar.

tasks.title: Run deterministic judge and targeted editorial audit
tasks.notes: No claim of cross-family review unless a genuinely different model family performs it.

phases.title: Interior Rebuild
phases.goal: Rebuild three 6x9 devotionals and three paired journals from the polished voice corpus, with optional monthly deep-dive pages and clean print behavior.

gates.title: All six PDFs have expected page counts and dimensions
Rendered PDF visual and overflow audit passes

tasks.title: Inject polished voice into devotional and journal interiors
tasks.notes: Preserve verified Scripture architecture and page anatomy.

tasks.title: Add monthly Correlative Weave deep-dive review spreads
tasks.notes: Depth lives in monthly review pages, not as daily-page clutter.

phases.title: Luminous Cover Family
phases.goal: Generate real bright cover art from Lady D's own descriptions, qualify it objectively, and present a ranked decision deck with matched journal directions.

gates.title: Cover manifest, luminance, and thumbnail gates pass
gates.notes: Average luminance target is at least 160/255; strategic shadows may support the light but may not dominate.

gates.title: Cover decision deck browser smoke test passes

tasks.title: Generate bright no-text cover candidates for all three volumes
tasks.notes: Prompts derive from Lady D's transcript and emailed reference, not generic SVG concepts.

tasks.title: Rank candidates and build author selection deck
tasks.notes: Real image renders only; typography remains an overlay after selection.

phases.title: Release Package
phases.goal: Publish review artifacts, provide an audiobook-ready narration blueprint, and ship a checksum-verified master ZIP.

gates.title: Static site and download links pass
Master ZIP manifest and checksums validate

tasks.title: Build audiobook chunking and pronunciation handoff
tasks.notes: Provider-neutral manifest supports GPT Voice, Gemini Live, Grok Voice, Hermes, or OpenClaw stitching.

tasks.title: Update live review site and create final ZIP

risks.title: Humanizer score can reward oversimplification
risks.note: Mitigated: the humanizer remained advisory; the August authored exemplar, protected fields, and deterministic editorial evidence outranked the style score.

risks.title: Longer natural prose can overflow 6x9 interiors
risks.note: Mitigated: all six PDFs passed exact 6x9 geometry, expected page counts, text-marker checks, representative renders, and automated overflow checks.

risks.title: Generated cover imagery can drift dark or embed malformed text
risks.note: Mitigated for author selection: ten no-text raster candidates passed luminance and dark-mass gates; final typography waits for Susan's selection and locked wrap dimensions.

risks.title: External author and KDP gates remain
risks.note: Susan's voice and theological approval, front matter, selected-cover wrap assembly, KDP Previewer, and a physical proof are required before public release.

nextActions: Ask Susan to review representative days from every month in all three devotionals and journals.
Record Susan's ranked cover selection, then assemble exact KDP wraps after page count and paper choice are locked.
Complete theological and permissions review, KDP Previewer, and a photographed physical proof.
Use the audiobook manifests only with human narration or a provider workflow explicitly authorized for the intended distributor.
blockers: Final author voice and theological approval has not yet been recorded.
Final cover typography, spine width, back matter, barcode, and KDP physical proof depend on author selection and production metadata.
conventions: Lady D's August 3 Exodus 15:4 email is the gold voice exemplar and must remain unchanged.
Scripture text, translation labels, root/language lenses, and correlative threads are immutable during voice polish.
Do not claim independent or cross-family review without a genuinely separate reviewer.
Every generated cover candidate must be real raster art with no baked title text.
